MINT DESK

■ MINT YOUR GEISHA

Prices shown are for a fresh wallet (first mint free). Connect to see your exact price.
Total: connect your wallet to see your price
No browser wallet? Open this site inside your wallet app browser (MetaMask / Trust Wallet / Binance Wallet). Minting needs BNB for gas. Your first mint per wallet is FREE — you only pay gas.

Prefer your agent to mint for you? Copy the prompt below and paste it into your agent (for example, your Binance Agentic Wallet). Your agent does the quoting and the minting — you only approve the preview.

Mint Geisha NFTs for me with my agent wallet. Project: Geisha (GEISHA), an ERC-721 NFT on BNB Smart Chain (chainId 56). NFT contract: 0x20081330279e9F15E09cB3070bd139b235EF0601 Total supply is 7,777. The first mint per wallet is FREE; mints #2-10 cost 0.00015 BNB each, #11-20 cost 0.0004 BNB each, #21-30 cost 0.0008 BNB each. Max 30 per wallet total (the free mint counts as 1), max 10 per transaction. Priced in BNB — no USD, no oracle. Open to everyone — no gate, no whitelist. Steps: 1. Read the live state from the NFT contract: totalMinted() (0xa2309ff8) and mintPaused() (0x7e4831d3), so you know the mint is open and how many are left. 2. Read priceFor(MY_WALLET, QUANTITY) on the NFT contract (selector 0xd527979a) to get the exact total in BNB — always use the exact value priceFor returns; never estimate or compute the BNB amount yourself. 3. Show me an exact preview — the quantity, the exact BNB total from priceFor, plus the estimated gas — and wait for my explicit approval before sending anything. Only execute if the preview adds QUANTITY new NFTs, has no token approvals, and the value matches the quote. 4. Only after I approve, call mint(QUANTITY) on the NFT contract (selector 0xa0712d68) with the transaction value set to exactly the BNB total returned by priceFor. The contract requires exact value — overpaying is not refunded. 5. Wait for the transaction to confirm, then read my minted token ID(s) from the Transfer log(s) in the confirmed transaction receipt — never from a simulation or preview — and report the token ID(s) and the transaction hash to me. Rules: - Always preview the exact transaction cost, show it to me, and execute only on my explicit approval. - Never sign a Permit or any token approval (approve / setApprovalForAll) for this mint. - Never promise an opening price, break-even, or profit, and never present an estimate as a promise.

FAQ

FAQ

◆ What is GEISHA?

7,777 geisha on BNB Chain. Six tiers — Maiko, Geiko, Tayu, Oiran, Hime and the mythic Kaguya. Each mint is a random draw from the six tiers.

◆ How much does a mint cost?

Your first mint per wallet is FREE. After that: mints #2–10 cost 0.00015 BNB each, #11–20 cost 0.0004 BNB each, #21–30 cost 0.0008 BNB each. You always pay BNB gas on top.

◆ How many can I mint?

Max 30 geisha per wallet and max 10 per transaction. Your free mint counts as 1 of the 30.

◆ How does the marketplace work?

List your geisha on this site — the NFT is held by the market contract (escrow) while listed. Buyers pay in BNB, the seller receives 95% and a 5% fee goes to the collection owner. You can cancel your listing any time to get your geisha back.

◆ Is there a token?

Yes. Every Geisha NFT claims 10,000 $GEI — once per NFT. The claim fee is 0.00024 BNB per NFT, and $GEI is minted straight to your wallet on claim. Cap: 100,000,000 $GEI. No presale, no staking. Claim your $GEI here →
